topics.title: Meta settles teen social media case
topics.summary: Meta reached an $18 billion settlement with states in a major trial over teen social media addiction claims, while the company continued defending its youth safety work.
topics.discussionPrompt: If the studio had to design a healthier social app, what feature would everyone argue about first?

topics.title: US-Canada trade thaw looks possible
topics.summary: Analysts say the US and Canada may eventually find a compromise in their trade dispute, even as new tariffs keep pressure on businesses and consumers.
topics.discussionPrompt: If two neighbors were stuck in a tariff squabble, what ridiculous peace offering would actually break the tension?

topics.title: Army plans base microreactors
topics.summary: The US Army plans to spend $2 billion adding small nuclear microreactors at five bases, aiming for more reliable power as energy demand rises.
topics.discussionPrompt: Would the studio trust a tiny power plant next door, or would someone immediately start naming safety rules?

topics.title: CIA director held Moscow talks
topics.summary: The Kremlin said the CIA director visited Moscow for talks with Russian intelligence counterparts, a rare public acknowledgment of high-level communication between the countries.
topics.discussionPrompt: When rivals quietly meet behind closed doors, who in the studio assumes chess strategy and who assumes awkward small talk?
